name: CrowdSec
description: Open-source intrusion prevention system with crowd-sourced threat intelligence and real-time attack detection.

env.label: Bouncer API Key
env.description: Pre-registered API key for a firewall bouncer

env.label: Collections
env.description: Space-separated list of collections to install (e.g. crowdsecurity/linux crowdsecurity/nginx)

env.label: Console Enrollment Key
env.description: Enrollment key from the CrowdSec Console for cloud integration

env.label: Instance Name
env.description: Name for this instance in the CrowdSec Console

env.label: Enrollment Tags
env.description: Comma-separated tags for this instance in the CrowdSec Console

env.label: Disable Agent
env.description: Disable the CrowdSec agent (run only the local API)
